svg.title: Racoon's Closet: every item, copper to diamond

g.title: River cap: a teal cap with a river stripe (copper)
Party hat: a coral cone with mango dots and a pom-pom (silver)
Salakot: a woven Filipino hat with a silver tip (silver)
Flower crown: sampaguita and a waling-waling orchid (violet)
Gold crown: Butuan gold with spirals, gems and pearls (gold)
Star crown: a crystal tiara with a faceted star gem (diamond)
Reading glasses: round copper frames (copper)
Sunglasses: dark lenses with a silver brow bar (silver)
Star glasses: star frames with pink-violet lenses (violet)
Golden hearts: heart lenses in gold rims with gems (gold)
Prism shades: a crystal visor with a rainbow lens (diamond)
Bow tie: plum with polka dots and a silver stud (silver)
Sampaguita lei: white jasmine with a waling-waling orchid (violet)
Sun medal: a gold sunburst medal on a teal and coral ribbon (gold)
Star pin: a copper button with a cream star (copper)
Heart pin: a coral heart on silver (silver)
Book pin: a little open book on silver (silver)
Balangay pin: Butuan's balangay boat on violet enamel (violet)
Gold rosette: a ribbon rosette with a gold star (gold)
Parol lantern: a Filipino Christmas star lantern that glows (violet)
Golden book: a gold cover and glowing pages with a golden star (gold)
Crystal storybook: an ice-crystal cover, rainbow pages and a star gem (diamond)
